source.author: ov
source.text: Gratantur Achivi victoremque tenent avidisque amplexibus haerent.
source.text_original: Gratantur Achivi / victoremque tenent avidisque amplexibus haerent.
source.text_english: The Achaeans rejoice and hold the victor, clinging to him with eager embraces.

reuse.author: val
reuse.text: Increscunt matrum gemitus et fortia languent corda patrum; longis flentes amplexibus haerent.
reuse.text_original: Increscunt matrum gemitus et fortia languent / corda patrum; longis flentes amplexibus haerent.
reuse.text_english: The mothers’ groans swell, and the fathers’ brave hearts grow faint; weeping, they cling in long embraces.
